snippet.title: The Search For Above Average Life // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3954290/The_Search_For_Above_Average_Life
Itch.io ► https://mckenzieraven.itch.io/the-search-for-above-average-life

A light-hearted bullet-hell adventure where friendship means overcoming the language barrier. Play as SAAL, a lonely exploration robot, scanning planets, dodging “misunderstanding” projectiles, and collecting “understanding” to befriend eccentric aliens.

Developed by 
M. Raven aka @McKenzieRaven
